name: poe2-endgame-companion
description: Path of Exile 2 character analysis and endgame companion. Merges POE2-MCP-V2 and Poe2-endgame.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @poe2/core && npm run build --workspace @poe2/web
scripts.//typecheck: The core must be BUILT first: apps/web resolves @poe2/core to its dist/, so typechecking the web app before that exists fails with 40 cascading errors.
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @poe2/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
